activities.name: Polymorph
activities.note: On a failed WIS save, the target is transformed into a beast whose CR is no higher than the target's CR (or level). Full statblock replacement (HP, attacks, abilities) is OUT OF SCOPE for v0 — the engine does not model form overlay. The target's game stats are replaced by the beast's; it retains alignment and personality. Reverts on 0 HP or duration end.

activities.name: Wall of Fire
activities.note: Wall is opaque from one side (caster's choice) which deals damage on entry or starting turn within 10 ft. The other side does no damage. Creatures within wall on cast make a DEX save.

activities.name: Greater Invisibility
activities.note: Target (and anything it carries) gains the Invisible condition for the duration. Unlike Invisibility, the spell does NOT end when the target attacks or casts a spell.

activities.name: Banishment
activities.note: On a failed CHA save, target is banished to a harmless demiplane (if native to your plane) or to its home plane (if outsider, possibly permanent if concentration is maintained for the full minute). v0 cannot model planar shifts — surfaces as a note. Target is Incapacitated while banished and reappears in the space it left when the spell ends.

activities.name: Dimension Door
activities.note: Teleport yourself, plus optionally one willing creature within 5 ft of you (and gear it carries up to its carrying capacity), to any spot within 500 ft you can visualize. If you'd arrive in an occupied space, both teleporters take 4d6 force damage and the spell fails to teleport.
